E2606

`jet registry yank` requires a version argument.

What

`jet registry yank` requires a version argument.

Why

A yank marks one specific published version as deprecated; without a version the command doesn't know which one to yank.

Fix

Run `jet registry yank <version>`, e.g. `jet registry yank 1.2.3`.
